p5.s: Sales of electric bicycles have grown ------- over the past five years.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ grown cần trạng từ → steadily (đều đặn).

p5.s: The board of directors ------- the merger proposal at yesterday's meeting.
p5.why: yesterday's meeting (quá khứ) → quá khứ đơn approved.

p5.s: The library is open ------- 9 A.M. to 8 P.M. on weekdays.
p5.why: from … to … = từ … đến …; between đi với and.

p5.s: Ms. Allen prefers to book her flights -------, rather than using a travel agent.
p5.why: Đại từ phản thân nhấn mạnh: chính cô ấy tự đặt vé → herself.

p5.s: The airline apologized for the ------- of the flight, which left two hours late.
p5.why: delay = sự chậm trễ (chuyến bay khởi hành trễ hai giờ).

p5.s: Mr. Ford explained the new safety rules very ------- to the workers.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ explained (very + trạng từ) → clearly.

p5.s: We will hold the awards ceremony outdoors ------- it rains.
p5.why: Tổ chức ngoài trời trừ khi trời mưa → unless (= if … not).

p5.s: There are only ------- seats left for tonight's performance, so book now.
p5.why: seats là danh từ đếm được số nhiều → a few; a little / much đi với danh từ không đếm được, every đi với số ít.

p5.s: Ms. Novak ------- the sales team since last March.
p5.why: since + mốc quá khứ → hiện tại hoàn thành has led.

p5.s: Mr. Grant's ------- to detail makes him an excellent editor.
p5.why: Sau sở hữu cách Mr. Grant's cần danh từ → attention (attention to detail = sự tỉ mỉ).

p5.s: Ms. Diaz was asked to ------- the company at the international trade fair.
p5.why: represent the company = đại diện cho công ty.

p5.s: Mr. Hughes will be away ------- a business trip until Thursday.
p5.why: on a business trip = đi công tác (cụm cố định).

p5.s: The new model is ------- than any other printer we sell.
p5.why: Có than → so sánh hơn: more reliable.

p5.s: All packages must ------- by 4 P.M. to be shipped the same day.
p5.why: Sau must cần động từ nguyên mẫu; gói hàng được nhận (bị động) → be received.

p5.s: The company gave each of ------- employees a holiday bonus.
p5.why: Trước danh từ employees cần tính từ sở hữu → its; it's = it is.

p5.s: ------- for the marketing position must have at least three years of experience.
p5.why: Người có kinh nghiệm → danh từ chỉ người Applicants; applications = đơn xin việc.

p5.s: The new policy will ------- employees to work from home two days a week.
p5.why: allow + tân ngữ + to V; let / make / have đi với động từ nguyên mẫu không to.

p5.s: ------- of the two candidates has the right experience for the job.
p5.why: Hai người + động từ số ít has → Neither; Both cần have, None / All dùng cho từ ba trở lên.

p5.s: While Mr. Park ------- the report, his computer suddenly shut down.
p5.why: Việc đang diễn ra trong quá khứ thì việc khác xen vào (shut down) → quá khứ tiếp diễn was writing.

p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ responded cần trạng từ → promptly (nhanh chóng).

p5.why: fasten a seat belt = thắt dây an toàn.

p5.s: The candidate ------- we interviewed yesterday has accepted our offer.
p5.why: Thay cho người, làm tân ngữ của interviewed → whom.

p5.s: The new phone is popular ------- it is light and has a long battery life.
p5.why: Vế sau nêu lý do được ưa chuộng → because.

p5.s: Our technicians provide ------- support to customers in all regions.
p5.why: Trước danh từ support cần tính từ → professional (chuyên nghiệp).

p5.s: ------- its small size, the café serves more than 300 customers a day.
p5.why: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ (its small size), ý trái ngược → giới từ Despite; Although cần mệnh đề, Because cần of.

p5.s: If the weather ------- good tomorrow, the picnic will be held in the park.
p5.why: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn → is.

p5.why: accommodate = có đủ chỗ cho (bao nhiêu người).

p5.s: The project was ------- difficult that the team needed an extra month.
p5.why: so + tính từ + that (quá … đến nỗi); such đi với danh từ.

p6.title: To: Rachel Gomez · From: Pinewood Books · Subject: Your order #4471
p6.text: Dear Ms. Gomez, Thank you for your recent order from Pinewood Books. Unfortunately, one of the three books you ordered, The Mountain Road, is temporarily out of stock. We {1} more copies from the publisher next week. {2} Your other two books were shipped this morning and should arrive within three days. We will send The Mountain Road separately as soon as it is available. {3}, you will not be charged any extra shipping fees. We apologize for the {4} and thank you for your patience.

gaps.why: Sách đang hết hàng, next week (tương lai) → will receive.

o: We did not want to delay the rest of your order.
The Mountain Road was published ten years ago.

Shipping costs will increase next month.
gaps.a: We did not want to delay the rest of your order.
gaps.why: Câu chèn giải thích vì sao gửi trước hai cuốn còn lại, nối với câu sau "Your other two books were shipped".
Thêm một điều có lợi cho khách (không tính phí gửi thêm) → In addition.

p6.title: Oakridge Community Garden: Plot Applications
p6.text: The Oakridge Community Garden is now accepting applications for garden plots for the coming season. Each plot measures three meters by four meters and {1} $40 per year. Because the number of plots is limited, early application is strongly recommended. For more information, please visit our Web site or speak to one of our {4} on Saturday mornings.

o: Seeds and plants, however, must be provided by the gardeners themselves.
The garden was once a parking lot.
Water prices in Oakridge have risen recently.
Applications for jobs at the garden are now closed.
gaps.a: Seeds and plants, however, must be provided by the gardeners themselves.

applications are received (bị động: đơn được nhận) → received.
Sau one of our cần danh từ số nhiều chỉ người → volunteers.

p6.title: Hillcrest Launches Electric Buses
p6.text: The city of Hillcrest introduced its first electric buses on Monday. Ten new buses now run on Route 4, which connects the train station with the university. {1} being quieter and cleaner than the old diesel ones, the buses are also cheaper to operate. City officials estimate that each bus will save about $15,000 per year in fuel costs. {2} "Riders have already told us how much they enjoy the smoother ride," said transportation director Alan Moore. The city plans to replace all of its {3} buses with electric models by 2030. Charging stations {4} at the main bus depot later this year.

gaps.why: Besides + V-ing = ngoài việc …; câu sau có also (thêm một lợi ích) → Besides.

o: The savings will be used to improve bus stops.
Diesel fuel is mainly imported from abroad.
Train tickets can be bought online.
gaps.a: The savings will be used to improve bus stops.
gaps.why: "The savings" chỉ khoản tiết kiệm nhiên liệu vừa nêu → câu chèn đứng ngay sau.
Trước danh từ buses cần tính từ → remaining (số xe còn lại).
later this year (tương lai), trạm sạc được lắp (bị động) → will be installed.

p6.title: To: All Staff · From: Accounting Department · Subject: Expense reports
p6.text: Starting on July 1, all expense reports must be submitted through our new online system. Paper forms will no longer {1}. A short training video is available on the company intranet. {3}, our staff will hold two information sessions in the main conference room next week. If you have any questions in the meantime, please contact Ji-woo Han {4} extension 210.

o: This means you will no longer need to keep paper copies.
The accounting department moved to the third floor last year.
Paper forms can be picked up in the supply room.
The conference room can hold forty people.
gaps.a: This means you will no longer need to keep paper copies.

Thêm một cách hỗ trợ nữa (buổi giới thiệu) bên cạnh video → Furthermore.

docs.title: Café Owners Turn Waste into Profit
docs.text: Two years ago, Lena and Marco Diaz began collecting used coffee grounds from their three cafés in Portview. docs.title: Old Mill Becomes Arts Center
docs.text: GRANVILLE — A 150-year-old flour mill on the Granville River will reopen next month as an arts center. [1] The building had been empty for nearly thirty years before a group of local artists bought it in 2023. [2] With the help of volunteers and a $1.2 million grant from the state, they restored the original brick walls and wooden beams. [3] The center will include eight artist studios, a gallery, and a café overlooking the river. [4] Classes in painting, pottery, and photography will be offered to the public starting in the fall. Thank you for your interest in Harborview Apartments. I would be happy to show you the unit that best matches your needs. Would Tuesday, June 3, at 5:00 P.M. work for you? Please bring a photo ID and proof of employment, such as a letter from your new employer. Since you mentioned your dog, please also note that there is a dog park right next to our building.
Best regards,
Kara Lindqvist
Leasing Manager

qs.q: What is indicated about all the units?
qs.ev: All units include a dishwasher and a washing machine.
qs.why: Căn nào cũng có máy rửa bát và máy giặt; chỉ từ tầng 5 trở lên có ban công.

qs.q: Which unit will Ms. Lindqvist most likely show Mr. Rivera?
qs.ev: We would also love to have a balcony
qs.why: Cần 2 phòng ngủ, có từ 1/7, muốn ban công (e-mail) → 5C (tầng 5 có ban công, trống từ 1/7); 4A ở tầng 4 không có ban công.

qs.q: How much will Mr. Rivera most likely pay each month?
qs.ev: Pets are allowed in all units for an additional $50 per month.
qs.why: Căn 5C $1,750 + $50 vì nuôi chó = $1,800.

qs.q: What is Mr. Rivera asked to bring?
qs.ev: Please bring a photo ID and proof of employment
qs.why: Mang giấy tờ có ảnh và giấy xác nhận việc làm.

qs.q: What does Ms. Lindqvist mention about the area?
qs.a: There is a park for dogs nearby.
w: There is a new shopping mall.
Parking is free on the street.
The harbor is closed in winter.
qs.ev: there is a dog park right next to our building
qs.why: Ngay cạnh toà nhà có công viên cho chó.

docs.title: Itinerary · Pacific Tours · Coastal Highlights (3 days)
docs.text:
Day 1 (Friday): Depart Seaton at 8:00 A.M. Visit Rocky Point Lighthouse. Overnight at the Bayview Inn.
Day 2 (Saturday): Morning whale-watching cruise. Afternoon free in Port Ellis. Overnight at the Bayview Inn.
Day 3 (Sunday): Guided hike through Cedar Forest. Return to Seaton by 6:00 P.M.
Price: $420 per person, including hotel, breakfast, and all activities. Single room supplement: $90.

docs.title: E-mail · To: Pacific Tours · From: Irene Walsh · Date: August 2 · Subject: Coastal Highlights tour, August 15–17
docs.text:
Hello,
I have booked the Coastal Highlights tour for August 15–17, and I'm really looking forward to it. I'll be traveling alone, so I booked a single room. Unfortunately, I've just learned that I have a family event on Sunday afternoon. Would it be possible for me to leave the group after the Saturday activities and take a bus back to Seaton on my own?
Best regards,
Irene Walsh

docs.title: E-mail · To: Irene Walsh · From: Pacific Tours · Date: August 3 · Subject: RE: Coastal Highlights tour, August 15–17
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Walsh,
Thank you for letting us know. You are welcome to leave the tour early. A bus leaves Port Ellis for Seaton every two hours from 7:00 A.M. on Sundays, and the trip takes about ninety minutes. Unfortunately, we cannot offer a refund for the activities you will miss, as the tour price has already been paid to our partners. Please inform your guide on Friday so that he can plan accordingly.
Sincerely,
Martin Cho
Pacific Tours

qs.q: What is included in the tour price?
qs.ev: including hotel, breakfast, and all activities
qs.why: Giá gồm khách sạn, bữa sáng và mọi hoạt động.

qs.q: How much did Ms. Walsh most likely pay for the tour?
qs.ev: I'll be traveling alone, so I booked a single room.
qs.why: Cô đi một mình, muốn phòng riêng (e-mail) → $420 + $90 phụ phí phòng đơn (lịch trình) = $510.

qs.q: Which activity will Ms. Walsh most likely miss?
qs.ev: leave the group after the Saturday activities
qs.why: Cô rời đoàn sau các hoạt động thứ Bảy (e-mail); ngày 3 (Chủ nhật) là đi bộ xuyên rừng Cedar (lịch trình).

qs.q: What does Mr. Cho say about the activities Ms. Walsh will miss?
qs.ev: we cannot offer a refund for the activities you will miss
qs.why: Không hoàn tiền cho hoạt động bỏ lỡ.

qs.q: What is Ms. Walsh asked to do?
qs.a: Tell her guide about her plans
qs.ev: Please inform your guide on Friday
qs.why: Báo cho hướng dẫn viên vào thứ Sáu.

docs.title: Notice · Holt & Partners · Office Renovation
docs.text:
The third floor of our building will be renovated from September 8 to October 3. During this time, employees from the third floor will work in temporary spaces:
Accounting: Room 210 (second floor)
Legal: Room 405 (fourth floor)
Human Resources: Room 412 (fourth floor)
Marketing: work from home on Mondays and Fridays; Room 220 on other days
Please pack your personal items by Friday, September 5. Moving boxes are available in the mailroom.

docs.title: E-mail · To: Facilities Team · From: Owen Burke · Date: September 2 · Subject: Renovation question
docs.text:
Hello,
I work in the Legal Department, and I often meet clients in our third-floor conference room. Will there be a room I can use for client meetings during the renovation? Also, I have a large set of files that won't fit in the moving boxes. Could someone help me move them?
Thanks,
Owen Burke

docs.title: E-mail · To: Owen Burke · From: Facilities Team · Date: September 3 · Subject: RE: Renovation question
docs.text:
Dear Mr. Burke,
Conference Room 4C, on the same floor as your temporary office, can be reserved for client meetings through the online booking system. As for your files, our team will bring a storage cart to your office on Thursday afternoon and move them for you.
Best regards,
Facilities Team

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
qs.ev: employees from the third floor will work in temporary spaces
qs.why: Thông báo chỗ làm tạm thời trong thời gian sửa tầng 3.

qs.q: On which floor will Mr. Burke work during the renovation?
qs.ev: I work in the Legal Department
qs.why: Anh làm ở phòng Pháp chế (e-mail); thông báo: phòng Pháp chế chuyển sang phòng 405, tầng 4.

qs.q: What does Mr. Burke ask for help with?
qs.ev: Could someone help me move them?
qs.why: Anh nhờ chuyển bộ hồ sơ lớn không vừa thùng.

qs.q: What is indicated about Conference Room 4C?
w: It is on the third floor.
It is only for the Legal Department.
qs.ev: can be reserved for client meetings through the online booking system
qs.why: Phòng 4C đặt qua hệ thống đặt chỗ trên mạng.

qs.q: When will the facilities team move Mr. Burke's files?
qs.ev: our team will bring a storage cart to your office on Thursday afternoon
qs.why: Chiều thứ Năm đội cơ sở vật chất mang xe đẩy tới chuyển giúp.
